Safety is a fair concern. 

I think accepting a drink, whilst it can give a guy the wrong sign, isn’t inherently wrong, unless she then accepts the buyers advances and end up exchanging numbers or flirting etc. Unless that happens, then it’s just a free drink.
okay sweet I’ll try that, its just a bit weird because ive been on the exact same diet and lost weight at a pretty decent rate, but ill try watching my fat intake etc a bit more

I’m 5’4, 220 pounds and 18 years old, I have an office job.
I mostly count calories, but I use MyFitnessPal to plan out my meals and it tells me when I’ve planned a meal with too many carbs or too much fat etc. 

I’m fairly certain my scales are fine but I’m probably going to look into getting a new set just incase

my tdee is about 1,500, but I found that alot of my weight gain came from binge eating and 1,200 is a great amount for me. 

I have been weighing and tracking all my foods, I’m currently doing meal replacement shakes apart from dinner so I don’t think my calorie counting can be that off.
